buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS (A) Terms & Conditions 1. The agency shall be responsible for compliance of government rules and instructions. The make of the vehicle shall not be earlier than 6 months ol d from the date of notice inviting e-tender and the vehicle shall be in goo d condition, with not driven more than 20,000 kms. upto the date of depl oyment.

2. The vehicle shall strictly be tagged with FasTag ID (Radio Frequency Iden tification Tag). 3. The agency shall furnish copies of documents mentioned at Annexure-I. All necessary taxes for operating the vehicle shall be fully paid by the ag ency as per prevailing Motor Vehicles Act with comprehensive insurance cover. All the cases related to accident/damages/compensation shall be r esponsibility of vehicle owner. 4. The agency shall quote the rates inclusive of all prevailing taxes, driver’s salary & other benefits, Fuel charges, repairs & maintenance of vehicle, i nsurance of vehicle and other relevant charges. The amount should be quoted in words and figures. In case of discrepanc y between two, the amount quoted in words will prevail. 6. The Agency at its own cost shall pay the charges of toll by fastag while tr aveling through the toll plazas. 7. The vehicle shall be provided to the user during day and night (24 hours) as per requirement of NHAI. 8. The Agency shall also make available Driver having valid driving license, with good experience. The driver at the time of service to NHAI shall be in grey safari suit only. 9. The Agency should ensure that sufficient fuel is always available for trav el. And no advance payment shall be made to agency, under any circums tances. 10. NHAI shall not pay to the driver any allowances during any festivals and outstation travels. 11. The daily duty chart with the mileage covered shall be countersigned fro m the concerned officer. The distance shall be enumerated from commen cing point to terminating point of the concerned officer. 12. The payment will be by RTGS duly deducting statutory charges if any, as per certificate given by concerned officer after verifying the total mileage of the month. 13. The driver shall be mentally and physically fit. Also, shall perform the dut

y sincerely and diligently. He should not consume alcohol or any intoxicants during duty hours. 14. In case of vehicle failure, the agency shall arrange for an alternative vehi cle immediately or shall bear the actual expenses incurred by the officer f or hiring an alternate taxi. 15. GPS tracking system v. Functional AC vi. Fire extinguisher & first aid kit vii. Sanitizer & umbrella viii. Infotainment system

ix. USB-C ports and multiple charging points x. Rear AC vents for passenger comfort 22. Ensure payment only through bank transfer directly to drivers account. (iv) Service Provider shall be the employer for his workers and NHAI w ill not be held responsible fully or partially for any dispute that ma

y arise between the service provider and his workers. 27.
